fusions.name: Coughed Hairball
fusions.desc: Spits a clinging hairball that deals 9 damage and has a 50% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Frizzed Fur
fusions.desc: Sends out a static-charged cone that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it, stuns each for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Shocked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fluffed Coat
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises 6% while it lasts. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Whisker Sense
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.
